div.div: Enter Idle sleep to execute the diagnostic. Wait for the Done interrupt to wake up the device and for the ISR to set ongoing = false through the Is Diagnostic Ongoing and Report Diagnostic Done APIs. Should another interrupt wake up the device, re-enter sleep. Assumes global interrupts are enabled, otherwise a sleep error is automatically reported.
